testRunner_comment: The command runner replaces the vitest plugin (Phase 02): @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner@10.0.0 declares peer vitest >=2, but under vitest 5.0.1 every per-mutant run completed zero tests (debug log + mutation.json testsCompleted:0), so no mutant was ever applied and all survived. The command runs with vitest.stryker.config.mjs (zero imports) because the sandboxed copy of vitest.config.ts resolves 'vitest/config' unreliably through the node_modules symlink on Windows and vitest 5 exits 0 on that startup error. Coverage is disabled explicitly: the coverage thresholds are a separate gate.
